fields.label: Stage Key
fields.description: Identifies the step. Set by the app: fixed for shipped steps, and generated for a step you add when it is first saved. Never changes afterwards.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: What the screens call this step. Rename freely -- documents follow the step, not its name.

fields.label: Waits In
fields.description: The workflow state a document waits in at this step. Fixed: documents carry it by name, so changing it would strand them. Rename the step through its label instead. A step you add is given one when it is first saved.

fields.label: Action
fields.description: The workflow action that leaves this step. Fixed for the same reason as Waits In; a step you add is given one when it is first saved.

fields.label: Per Unit
fields.description: On: this step is taken separately for each unit work is scoped by, so one unit's approvals cannot reach another's.

fields.label: Required
fields.description: On: this step cannot be switched off. A chain needs a way in, so its first step is always required.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off drops this stage from the approval chain, and the step before it approves straight through to the next one. Submit stages cannot be switched off.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The role allowed to take this step. Approvers listed below are granted it.
